page.overview:
Who is Bedroom Assassin?

The bedroom assassin was an assassin for SPECTRE, who was sent to assassinate James Bond, but accidentally killed Aki. The character appears as a supporting antagonist in the 1967 James Bond film You Only Live Twice.

This Unnamed individual was hired by SPECTRE to assassinate James Bond by dropping lethal poison from the ceiling while he and Aki are sleeping. However, the attempt was unsuccessful and Aki was instead killed by the poison, while the Assassin was shot and killed by Bond which trying to make a getaway.
